findings.failure_path: Test 3d fails Ruby on its 3rd call and then checks only that the exit code is nonzero. If the visibility step is not the 3rd Ruby call, for example after the pre-rg passes are reordered, the injected failure hits a different step. That step still exits nonzero, so the test passes even if a regression brings back the swallowed-failure install_visibility_not_found path.
findings.smallest_fix: Also assert that out3d contains install_visibility_scan_error and does not contain install_visibility_not_found.

concern_results.conclusion: All four earlier P2 items are fixed in this delta. ccl-skills.ts now skips a repo-test file only when it exists on one side. check-contract-anchors rejects absolute paths, '..' paths and paths that resolve outside root. init_policy_matrix runs each case in a fresh namespace. validate-skill stops with exit 2 when the Ruby name-extraction step fails.

Shared test scripts are now compared byte-for-byte, and anchor paths must stay inside root. Extra test files on one side are still accepted on purpose, as the AC-4 parity design intends. No new write path.

An empty or root-equal anchor path is reported as malformed. A failed Ruby name extraction now exits 2 instead of printing install_visibility_not_found. A load error in the compiled parser still marks all 270 cases unparseable.

The tampered-shared-test-script, M10 path-escape and single-use-globals tests each check the behavior they target. Test 3d is weaker: it only checks for a nonzero exit code and depends on the order of Ruby calls (see the finding).
The delta stays within the previous review's findings, and the CLI output tokens are unchanged. YAML.load(File.read) behaves the same as the old load_file call.
No state is migrated, so a git revert undoes the change cleanly.
Two new tokens are added: install_visibility_scan_error and contract_anchor_row_malformed (path escapes root). Both are specific enough to diagnose the failure.
The edits to plan.md match the code. The wording 'No gate verdict is loosened' is now accurate, since the change only makes checks stricter.
The parity bypass in the OpenCode owner-evidence check is closed for shared files. Hardlinked or symlinked repo-test files are still rejected.
The fixtures are synthetic, and the validator changes come with fixture tests, as the skill-extraction scripts AGENTS.md requires. No contract file is loosened.
